That is all for now, Captain.

Saber 6 out.

notes.title: The Voices of Command
notes.content:
[h1]
Authentic sound effects have been a top priority from the beginning. Just like the soldiers on the ground in WW2, players will be able to hear the difference between a U.S. M2 Heavy Machine Gun (50 cal) and a German MG42 (Hitler's Buzzsaw). They will even be able to hear the difference between a Panzer IV and a Sherman...Again, just like the men who heard these sounds on the war-torn fields of Europe.

As development continued, we realized that there was one type of sound we were missing...People.

So we decided to add voice overs. Like the vehicles and equipment in the field, each man under your command will have his own voice, his own personality, his own words.

We knew we needed help to do this right. So we found  top-notch Voice Director, Maurice Suckling.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33420403/7086f783fa3513d7d7a2f5c95a5b34ad0c1584f0.jpg[/img]

Maurice brings a vast amount of experience and expertise. We are very lucky to have him.

Please join us in welcoming Maurice to the Burden of Command team!

As always, thank you all for your support,
Rob

[/h1]

tags.feature: So we decided to add voice overs.

notes.title: The Lived-In Look
notes.content:
[h1]
Good Morning Captain,


As you know, this ain't the battlefield our fathers knew. Things have changed sine The Great War. Armies don't just run on their stomach these days; they also run on their fuel tanks.

The theater of operations you are about to enter will reflect that. Your ears will ring with the growl of diesel engines and the squeal of tank tracks. Your eyes will burn from the acrid clouds of their exhaust. The smell of burning petrol will stick in your nose for weeks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33420403/dde3199d02e7c3b1760f39cdbac9d6a6c91ed2ea.jpg[/img]

But remember, these steel beasts don't drive themselves. They are driven, operated, and maintained by living, breathing men. These aren't merely fighting machines; they are homes to the men who crew them...Often for months at a time.

Our team back at HQ realizes this, so we changed the animations to better reflect the human side of mechanized warfare.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33420403/7f0b19336bfba2267376c76df4a2b61a3c206424.jpg[/img]

You can see the full story, along with some shots of our own veterans in their rolling homes here:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w3jMwd5V04M&feature=youtu.be][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33420403/ed8975b642519614b8d409e5dafe30ad6531b64b.jpg[/img][/url]

All vehicles in Burden of Command will get this treatment to give them 'the lived-in look' both for authenticity and to respect the real men who called them home.

This concludes today's briefing.

Saber 6 out.
[/h1]

notes.content:
[h1]Hello Again!

That's right, today we offer you [b][u]t[/u][u]wo updates in one[/u][/b]!

You may have seen Burden of Command's development roadmap in the discussions area. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33420403/cbaa598143a1dddda16a10ec9c5e4720729473e1.jpg[/img]

The subjects of today's updates are the first two items on the roadmap.

[b][u]Update #1: Basic Tactical Features[/u][/b]

As a Commanding Officer, you will face many tactical dilemmas. The battlefield is a chaotic and deadly place. 

What is that ahead? It's...It's...TANKS!!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33420403/29812dcbeccdcad24fa00ab49b3302d3f35efe72.png[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H1Hc9N635hM]Watch this video[/url] to see an example of the tough battlefield choices you'll have to make.


[b][u]Update #2: Narrative[/u][/b]

Not all decisions happen on the battlefield...

You happen upon a local. He claims to have useful information. He says he wants to help. Can you trust him?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33420403/6ab2dc90aed4164c098e28a00a11630e9ea23c2b.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w76RbicNN9o]Watch this video[/url] for a taste of the narrative choices you will face.

You are in Command, Captain. You have your mission. Your men's lives are in your hands. What will you do?

I hope you liked these sneak peeks.

As always, we would greatly appreciate adding Burden of Command to your wishlist and [url=http://eepurl.com/cLtwsj]joining our newsletter[/url] to get even more news and updates.

We'll be back tomorrow with even more news!

Rob
[/h1]
